#define LDAP_LIST_REMOVE(elm, field) do {				\ /* <=== include/ldap_queue.h:353:358:LDAP_LIST_REMOVE:2 */ 
	if ((elm)->field.le_next != NULL)				\
		(elm)->field.le_next->field.le_prev = 			\
		    (elm)->field.le_prev;				\
	*(elm)->field.le_prev = (elm)->field.le_next;			\
} while (0)

#define LDAP_LIST_INSERT_HEAD(head, elm, field) do {			\ /* <=== include/ldap_queue.h:344:349:LDAP_LIST_INSERT_HEAD:3 */ 
	if (((elm)->field.le_next = (head)->lh_first) != NULL)		\
		(head)->lh_first->field.le_prev = &(elm)->field.le_next;\
	(head)->lh_first = (elm);					\
	(elm)->field.le_prev = &(head)->lh_first;			\
} while (0)
